rationale: Adds begin_file_drag to the generic platform layer: an outbound drag of existing files from any NSView, offering copy and/or move, with an optional drag image and a once-only report of the destination's operation through a MainThreadScope, plus a recorder seam so automation and tests can start and observe a drag without a pointer event. Additive and free of view or render dependencies (the view layer's own drag is unchanged), so the next Vellum re-export of core/platform should carry it.
